# QoL feature-set files synchronized from the QoL source branch into every
# other version branch.
#
# This file is the manifest consumed by .github/scripts/sync-qol.sh.
# Paths are relative to src/main/java/com/stash/hunt/.
#
# Rules that keep this manifest honest:
#   1. Every line must exist as a source file under
#      src/main/java/com/stash/hunt/ on the QoL source branch.
#   2. The files are FEATURE implementations that are branch-agnostic apart
#      from MC mappings -- the whole file is overwritten with the migrated
#      version. NEVER add a file here whose content is version-specific
#      (e.g. a branch-pinned import that exists on some versions only).
#   3. Branch-specific metadata files (Addon.java, *mixins.json, build.gradle,
#      gradle.properties) are handled SEPARATELY by apply_manifest.py with
#      idempotent inserts -- they are NOT overwritten.
#
# SOURCE RESOLUTION (sync-qol.sh):
#   The live origin/<source_branch> HEAD is used by default so new 26.2 QoL
#   commits propagate automatically. The "Last synced from" line below is the
#   last validated baseline: it labels the PR delta and serves as a fallback
#   if the live branch cannot be resolved. Bump it when a sync set has been
#   reviewed and merged across targets.
#
# Last synced from: 26.2 @ 8df2d48 (TripResumer echo fix / full QoL set)
